snippet.title: Saturn Longplay [084] Wolf Fang: Kuhga 2001 SS
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

In this game you can construct your mecha. Also you can chose your path after level 2 so I went for the A path in the main longplay. 

00:04:27 Path through levels 1, 2, 3-A, 4-A and 5-A which gives you the good ending.

00:35:45 Alternate good ending with both players
00:36:37 Alternate good ending if played as the second player

After level 2 you can chose a different path so here they are (I also chose another mecha):


00:37:28 Path through 3-A,  4-B and 5-B which give you B bad ending

00:56:45 Alternate B bad ending if played as the second player
00:57:59 Alternate B bad ending if played as both players


00:59:25 Path through 3-B, 4-C and 5-C

01:17:46 Alternate C bad ending if played as the second player
01:19:03 Alternate C bad ending if played as both players


01:20:38 Path through 3-B, 4-D and 5-D

01:39:01 Alternate D bad ending if played as the second player
01:40:12 Alternate D bad ending if played as both players -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
